name: Software product delivery
summary: Capability maps, now/next/later roadmaps and product development lifecycle (PDLC) slides for a software product build and enhancement offering, with the SDLC drawn as an overlay.

templates.name: Capability map, domain columns with status
templates.purpose: Map a product's capabilities as tiles under four domain headings, with tile surface showing live, in build, planned and not started.

slide.title: Access and billing are live; care builds next

templates.name: Capability map, heat bands by domain
templates.purpose: Show where to invest across a product as four ruled bands of capability tiles, with tile surface as a four-step heat scale and a legend.

slide.title: Investment concentrates on scheduling and integration

templates.name: Capability map, platform layers by owner
templates.purpose: Stack a product's experiences, services, data and platform capabilities in four layers, with card surface showing who builds each and a cross-cutting column.

slide.title: Every layer has a clear build owner

source.text: Sample names for layout only; replace with the client product inventory.

templates.name: Now, next, later roadmap
templates.purpose: Three columns of product capabilities under Now, Next and Later, each with a one-line theme.

slide.title: Three horizons take the patient app from booking to care

templates.name: Roadmap grid, horizons by capability group
templates.purpose: Dense now, next and later roadmap with horizons as columns and capability groups as rows; each cell lists two or three releases.

slide.title: Releases by capability group across three horizons

templates.name: Roadmap grid, capability groups as columns
templates.purpose: Dense now, next and later roadmap transposed: horizons as rows, four capability groups as columns, each cell a short release list.

slide.title: Each capability group moves through three horizons

templates.name: Now, next, later roadmap with section rail
templates.purpose: Now, next and later columns with an outcome line and squad-labelled releases, inside a long deck's navigation rail.

slide.title: Each horizon ships one outcome patients can feel

templates.name: Now, next, later roadmap with tall lanes
templates.purpose: A tall column of three horizon lanes, each with six releases and an outcome line, beside a short column of reading guidance.

slide.title: Three horizons take the patient app from booking to care

body.text: Horizons are planning commitments, not dates.

templates.name: PDLC with SDLC overlay, high level
templates.purpose: Four product development lifecycle phases as chevrons, the SDLC drawn as a bracketed band that starts partway into Define and ends partway into Optimize, with one line and one exit gate per phase.

slide.title: Four phases carry a product from idea to value

body.p: Find the patient and clinician problems worth solving first.
Shape the product, the experience and the delivery plan.
Deliver working software in short, tested, shippable releases.
Measure adoption and value, then improve what is live.

templates.name: PDLC with observations and activities table
templates.purpose: PDLC chevrons with the SDLC band beneath, and a table of what we typically observe and what we do in each phase.

slide.title: What we see and do in each phase

p3: No loop back to the backlog

templates.name: PDLC with sub-phases and SDLC overlay
templates.purpose: Each PDLC phase broken into three sub-phases, with tiles that fall inside the SDLC band marked by the step they belong to.

slide.title: Each phase has three sub-phases; the SDLC is one slice

templates.name: PDLC with roles and deliverables
templates.purpose: PDLC chevrons with the SDLC band beneath, and for each phase the lead roles and the deliverables it produces.

slide.title: Who leads each phase and what it delivers

templates.name: PDLC sub-phases in a tall column with SDLC bracket
templates.purpose: Four PDLC phases as tall rows with three sub-phases each, and the SDLC as a bracketed column that starts partway into Define and ends partway into Optimize.

slide.title: Four phases, with the SDLC inside them

items.text: deliver it and prove the value.
covers design through release, inside the product lifecycle.

body.text: The SDLC starts partway into Define and ends partway into Optimize.

templates.name: Product build and enhancement track overview
templates.purpose: One slide that summarizes the product build and enhancement track: what we do in each PDLC phase, the SDLC overlay and the outcome of each phase.

slide.title: Track 1 takes Northfield products from idea to value

body.p: A funded, ranked set of product bets
A scoped plan the board can approve
Releases patients can use every week
Measured adoption and a living backlog
